text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Thank you for today. See you tomorrow, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After spending the day out with Super Creek, I suddenly recall that one day.

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: These first three years of the Twinkle Series are the most important to an Umamusume, right?

text_block_list.name: Serious Trainer
text_block_list.text: That kind of complacent mindset leaves no room for an Umamusume to grow.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: My trainer is very considerate of me. You don't need to worry about us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to study hard to be as helpful as possible to Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the next two days, I study various training methods non-stop until…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …Trainer.
choice_data_list: What are you up to at this hour?
What are you up to at this hour?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'm worried about you…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Lately, you've been up staying up late to study, right?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You'll get sick if you keep this up.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I love how hard-working you are, but overexerting yourself is a big no-no.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Training is something we should think about and work hard on together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: There's no reason for you to struggle on your own.
choice_data_list: I'm doing it for myself as well.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …In that case, I want you to take today off. It's the least you can do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek is close to tears. I can't make her worry like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The moment I stand up to go home…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Darkness envelops me.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh! Are you awake now?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You collapsed.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: It's probably due to lack of sleep… But whatever the reason, you've been pushing yourself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Have I… been worrying you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You've been pushing yourself too hard with your studies…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: If being my trainer is putting too much pressure on you, then…
choice_data_list: The only thing that's worrying me is my own inability.
The only thing that's worrying me is my own inability.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: If being my trainer is putting too much pressure on you, then…
choice_data_list: The only thing that's worrying me is my own inability.
The only thing that's worrying me is my own inability.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: …Thank goodness. Hearing you open up like this about it really makes me feel relieved.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You are my one and only trainer. No one can replace you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: The more you overextend yourself, the more worried I get.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: So please, don't make me worry so much.
choice_data_list: I'll be more careful from now on.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Good. All right then, I'll sing you a lullaby now.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Go to sleep. ♪ Go to sleep. ♪ Go to sleep, little trainer. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Super Creek pats the futon in my office with her hand and puts me to bed with a lullaby.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You've already worked plenty hard for me. More than plenty, in fact.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I don't care what anyone says. We should keep going at our own pace.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: And if that still makes you feel anxious…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Then I'll spoil you silly until all those cares melt away!
choice_data_list: You already pamper me too much!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Not nearly enough! I know that for a fact.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, do you need someone to hold you while you sleep? I'll shower you with all the love I have! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decline the offer and swear not to push myself too hard in the future…
